node.title: A=1 core-one active-partition incidence reconstruction
node.statement: For either live active system, the saturated-row by clean-slope nonincidence graph is connected with both same-side pairs sharing a neighbor. Monic locator ratios factor into unique row/column potentials and satisfy every alternating-cycle identity. Conversely, incidence consistency, those cycle identities, and coefficientwise membership of the scaled clean locators in RS[Z_cl,e_*+1] are necessary and sufficient to reconstruct the unique compatible biform up to scalar; all saturated fibers then follow automatically. The clean-locator, saturated-locator, and core value matrices have exact rank sr(Q), at least five and exactly e+1 when b=0. This is exact classification preprocessing, not a Hankel or irreducibility test.
